# meraki_organization_policies_global_group_policy_appliance_vlan_assignment (Data Source)

This data source can read the `Organization Policies Global Group Policy Appliance VLAN Assignment` configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "meraki_organization_policies_global_group_policy_appliance_vlan_assignment" "example" {
  id              = "12345678"
  organization_id = "123456"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The id of the object
- `organization_id` (String) Organization ID

### Read-Only

- `interface_id` (String) Interface ID of the appliance VLAN assigned to the policy, as exposed by the `meraki_appliance_vlan` data source
- `policy_id` (String) ID of the organization-wide policy
